text: Wrote for their sons or daughters too?
Only ones to write lyrics in Salim-Javed scripts?
They've been many other lyricists, but you're on a good track
Correct, these are the only external dialogue writer credits on their films. For all the remaining, they wrote the dialogues themselves.
Gulzar wrote for Seeta aur Geeta, Inder Raj Anand for Andaz, and Nasir Hussain and Manoj Kumar wrote for Yaadon ki Baaraat and Kranti respectively, the films they also directed.
